description: Tracks sparse, pinned reference snapshots for projects whose detection patterns, scans, and tests inform jactionlint. Pins identify source snapshots; they do not promise API compatibility or runtime interoperability.

rows.notes: Review changed detection source, tests, and pattern fixtures for behavior jactionlint should cover; the historical diagnostics test remains a separate CI regression check, not evidence of candidate coverage.
Review changed audit scans, patterns, tests, and audit IDs against jactionlint checks; report newly added audits without a local mapping.
Review changed ShellCheck patterns, scans, and tests for behavior jactionlint should cover; do not infer API or runtime compatibility from this source pin.
Review changed Pyflakes patterns, scans, and tests for behavior jactionlint should cover; do not infer API or runtime compatibility from this source pin.
